data.description: Found while building tab-agent-signals (PR #463): a stand-in claude binary at a long path (/private/tmp/claude-501/.../claude) was classified as 'unknown', while the same binary at /tmp/fb/claude classified as claude-code. Likely cause: ps comm truncation with a long argv0 defeats AgentDetector's argv0 rule. Real-world impact: agents launched via long absolute paths (worktree-local binaries, nix/homebrew cellar paths, version-manager shims) may lose harness detection, and with it the agent tag and model detection. Fix: resolve the executable from the full argv[0] or proc_pidpath rather than the truncated comm, then add a test with a >16-char basename and a long directory path.
data.title: AgentDetector misses agents launched through a long argv0 path

data.body:
# C11-246 plan

## Root cause (measured)

`ps -o pid=,ppid=,tty=,tpgid=,comm=,args=` on this Mac:

- `comm` prints argv[0] in a column capped at 16 characters (the `comm` keyword's max width, MAXCOMLEN). `/tmp/fb/claude` is 13 characters, so the basename survives and classifies as claude-code. A long absolute path is clipped to a prefix (`/private/tmp/cla`), and that prefix's basename is not the agent.
- `args` is the last column. Piped `ps` prints the full argv (it already read KERN_PROCARGS2). The classifier's argv0 rule would work if it saw that string.
- `parsePSLine` means to skip whitespace runs but walks one character at a time, so each padding space in the tty column counts as a column. A live line is `??` plus 10 spaces. The reconstructed args therefore starts at `tpgid` (`0 /clipped /full/path/claude`). The argv0 rule reads `0` and ignores the real path on purpose. Result: `unknown`.

`proc_pidpath` on the same pid returns the full executable path. It is a syscall, not a process spawn.

## Fix

- Advance `parsePSLine` past each whitespace run so args is the real argv line.
- For the foreground pid only, call `proc_pidpath` and classify on that basename as well as comm and argv0. No extra spawn; the one `ps` per sweep stays.
- Treat runtime (`node`/`bun`/`deno`/`python*`) and shell basenames from those same untruncated names, so a long interpreter path still sees the script.
- Do not prefix-match. A 21-character basename that merely starts with `claude-code` stays unknown. Symlink targets (`…/2.1.286`) do not override an argv0 basename of `claude`.

## Tests

In `c11Tests/AgentDetectorTests.swift`, through `ProcessFacts` / `parsePSLine` (no live process):

- Short path `/tmp/fb/claude` still classifies as claude-code.
- Long directory path (padded ps line, and facts whose args were sliced to `0`) classifies as claude-code.
- Basename longer than 16: the parser keeps the full component; a clipped comm is not prefix-matched to `claude-code`; a registered basename delivered only on the executable path still classifies.

## Validation

No local xcodebuild. CI `build` compiles and runs the tests.

PR https://github.com/Stage-11-Agentics/c11/pull/471 at f8013d10fa1ed6d3db25f7fab49e418b456d2d90. CI checks passed, including build. ps comm is a 16-character clip of argv0, and parsePSLine treated tty padding spaces as extra columns so the argv0 token was "0". Classification now uses the full argv line and proc_pidpath.

Repair pushed daca6111461e1a220f0c375e1fa39b69c44a718a on https://github.com/Stage-11-Agentics/c11/pull/471. parsePSLine now has a live ps -t fixture (ttysNNN, two-space pad) that classifies grok from the full argv0, and executablePath(for:) calls proc_pidpath on this process and matches _NSGetExecutablePath after resolving symlinks. Waiting on CI.
CI green on daca6111461e1a220f0c375e1fa39b69c44a718a. HANDOFF sent. https://github.com/Stage-11-Agentics/c11/pull/471

PR #471 squash-merged to main as f767f306f645a89f013ddd721f6b2e8ee5cad8e4. Fresh-context Opus review PASS at f8013d10f (root cause confirmed against real ps -t output: padded tty column made parsePSLine take the 16-char comm clip as argv0; proc_pidpath correct, off-main, one syscall per foreground pid; no wrapper/shim regressions). Test-only repair delta at daca61114 attested by orchestrator: adds ttysNNN line-shape test and a real proc_pidpath-on-getpid test; both ran and passed in CI Logic tests (gate), run 36822207402. All PR checks green.
